<function name="PacketLoss" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
    <description>Returns the percentage of packets lost by the client. It is not networked so it only returns 0 when run clientside.</description>
    <realm>Shared</realm>
    <rets>
        <ret name="" type="number">Percentage of packets lost (0-100)</ret>
    </rets>
</function>
